correction: Previous navigation intervals exclude Brave native window setup but include Vox native window setup. They cannot establish comparable page-only costs. Full startup was counted in the Wikipedia and Old Reddit reports.
metric: Hardware-retired CPU instructions from audited exclusive macOS resource coalitions, including exited owned helpers and explicit coalition-owned services; GPU execution and outside services excluded.

replay.network_policy: Loopback replay only; fresh caches; Cache-Control: no-store

workload.profile_cache_policy: Fresh private cache/profile each trial; OS filesystem and shader caches are not cleared
workload.launch_scope: Exclusive browser resource-coalition creation through encoded document PNG availability, including browser/window startup and the navigation/capture workflow described by navigation_scope. Brave includes CDP target/window setup. OS filesystem and shader caches are not cleared. This is a full startup/capture workflow, not isolated page navigation or rendering work.
workload.navigation_scope: Navigation request to encoded document PNG availability, fresh process/profile/cache, 1024x768 CSS pixels, recorded device scale, cached fixture replayed over loopback HTTP. Vox native markers exclude PNG file write; Brave CDP response includes base64/IPC delivery and readiness polling. Vox requests its initial navigation before presenting its first native window frame; Brave creates and resizes an about:blank window before the measured navigation request. Both browsers use inactive native windows on the display away from the pointer. Exclusive resource coalitions include exited helpers and coalition-owned Metal compiler and CascadeSets update services; GPU execution and services outside the coalition are excluded. Full story/comment-row identity is checked after the measured PNG endpoint. The asymmetric window setup makes this interval diagnostic only. This is a capture workflow comparison, not identical internal rendering endpoints.

historical_v_profile_cohort.limitation: The first large Vox observation made the prior worst-case startup gate fail. The new cohort does not erase it or establish a cold-system guarantee.

comparability.differences: Those reports use a process-tree backend and 1x captures with different scripting policies. This report retains the existing windowed 2x original-script HN workload. Cross-site absolute totals are not identical experiments.
